query: ToolLLM 的核心贡献是什么？
answer: ToolLLM 是一个通用的工具使用框架，涵盖数据构建、模型训练和评估，并提出了用 ChatGPT 自动构建的指令微调数据集 ToolBench。
support_quote: we introduce ToolLLM, a general tool-use framework encompassing data construction, model training, and evaluation. We first present ToolBench, an instruction-tuning dataset for tool use
title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs

query: ToolLLM 如何解决多工具指令中工具组合稀疏的问题？
answer: ToolLLM 利用 RapidAPI 的层级信息，从同一类别或集合中随机选择 2-5 个工具，并从每个工具中最多采样 3 个 API 来生成指令。
support_quote: we randomly select 2-5 tools from the same category / collection and sample at most 3 APIs from each tool to generate the instructions
title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs

query: ToolLLM 的 API 检索器是如何训练的？
answer: API 检索器基于 BERTBASE 用 Sentence-BERT 训练为稠密检索器，将指令和 API 文档编码为两个嵌入并计算相似度；训练时把指令的相关 API 作为正例，并采样其他 API 作为负例进行对比学习。
support_quote: The API retriever encodes the instruction and API document into two embeddings, and calculates their relevance with embedding similarity
title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs

query: ToolLLM 在 ToolBench 主实验中的主要结果是什么？
answer: Vicuna 和 Alpaca 无法通过任何指令；对所有 LLM 而言，使用 DFSDT 在通过率和胜率上都显著优于 ReACT，ChatGPT+DFSDT 甚至超过 GPT-4+ReACT。
support_quote: Both Vicuna and Alpaca fail to pass any instruction (pass rate & win rate = 0), which means their instruction-following abilities do not cover the tool-use domain
title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs

query: ToolLLM 在分布外泛化实验中的结果如何？
answer: ToolLLaMA 在三个数据集上都取得了显著的分布外泛化表现；具体而言，ToolLLaMA+其 API 检索器在 HuggingFace 和 TorchHub 上的 AST 准确率均优于两种训练设置下的 Gorilla+BM25。
support_quote: ToolLLaMA+our API retriever outperforms Gorilla+BM25 from both training settings (ZS / RS) in terms of AST accuracy on HuggingFace and TorchHub
title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
